briefdescription.para: aring-style adapter for arbitrary-precision complex intervals, stored as (MPFI, MPFI) pairs.

detaileddescription.para: ElementType is cci_struct MPFI intervals for the real and imaginary components, so arithmetic yields rigorous containing intervals. mPrecision sets the per-bound MPFR precision. ringID = ring_CCi.
